parts.text: Keep the same character, pose, red tricycle, burgundy pinafore dress, cream blouse with black ribbon and the TV static backdrop. Changes: 1) Give her slightly longer black hair, chin length, sculpted in glossy wet-look black clay with visible clay strands and sculpting marks. 2) Make the whole figure clearly 3D claymation: matte plasticine with fingerprint texture and soft studio light, not a painted realistic doll. 3) Make the face an original design: replace the red spiral cheek circles with three small dark red teardrop cracks under each eye, keep the hinged puppet jaw lines, and use dark plum lips instead of bright red. Head turned about 45 degrees to the right. No text.
